title: Very good gradings on structural matrix rings
summary: Let $R$ be a nonzero associative unital ring, let $G$ be a group, and let $ρ$ be a preorder on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. A $G$-grading on $ρ$ induces a very good $G$-grading on the structural matrix ring $M_n(ρ,R)$. We show that, for each of the properties trivial, symmetric, epsilon-strong and strong, the grading on $ρ$ has the property if and only if the induced ring grading does. The epsilon-crossed product and crossed product properties pass from $ρ$ to the ring, but the converses fail in general.
